Game Overview

Alien Princess puts players into a girls' experience centered on explore a distant planet and style two alien princesses with intergalactic flair. From vine and feather forest looks to oceanic ensembles of pearls and algae, create unique fashion statements. Embark on a cosmic, nature-inspired fashion parade, complete with hairstyles, tattoos, and makeup. Save your out-of-this-world creations!

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Alien Princess is easy to pick up. Explore a distant planet and style two alien princesses with intergalactic flair!
